title: How bad is time variability for users in mobility services? An economic framework under expected- and non-expected utility
abstract: arXiv:2603.09142v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Time variability is a pervasive feature of mobility services and a major source of welfare loss. Although literature has quantified the cost of time variability (COTV), it remains theoretically unclear how bad time variability can be in the worst case. Without such a benchmark, quantified variability costs lack a principled reference for assessing whether they are economically meaningful. Meanwhile, this benchmark is critical for strategic prioritization in transport appraisal, service design, and pricing -- particularly in early-stage decision making where detailed valuation is often infeasible. To fill this gap, this paper develops an expected utility (EU) framework to quantify the cost of time (COT) and COTV, establishing theoretical upper bounds on the ratio $COTV/COT$. translated_title: 时间变异性对出行服务用户的影响究竟有多严重？一个基于期望效用与非期望效用的经济框架
translated_abstract: 时间变异性是出行服务中普遍存在的特征，也是福利损失的主要来源。尽管已有文献对时间变异性成本（COTV）进行了量化，但在理论上，时间变异性在最坏情况下可能有多严重仍不清楚。缺乏这样的基准，量化的变异性成本便缺少一个有原则的参照，无法判断其在经济上是否有意义。同时，这一基准对于交通评估、服务设计和定价中的战略优先级排序至关重要——尤其是在详细估值往往不可行的早期决策阶段。为填补这一空白，本文构建了一个期望效用（EU）框架来量化时间成本（COT）与时间变异性成本（COTV），并建立了比值 $COTV/COT$ 的理论上界。对于具有二次效用的用户，我们证明 $COTV/COT \le 1/2 CV^2$，其中 $CV$ 为服务时间的变异系数。对于泊松过程这一常见的假设情形，……
tldr: 本文构建期望效用框架量化时间成本与时间变异性成本，首次给出 COTV/COT 比值的理论上界（如二次效用下 COTV/COT ≤ ½CV²），为出行服务中时间变异性的最坏情况经济损失提供了评估基准。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an expected utility framework that establishes theoretical upper bounds on the ratio of the cost of time variability to the cost of time (e.g., COTV/COT ≤ ½CV² under quadratic utility), providing a worst-case benchmark for assessing time variability losses in mobility services.
